description: Rep. Josiah Hill represents Minnesota House District 33B, serving Stillwater, Scandia, Forest Lake, Oak Park Heights, and Bayport. His legislative priorities include affordable, high-quality healthcare for all Minnesotans, equitable public education, environmental protection, building a thriving and diverse economy for working families, ensuring equal opportunities through an Equal Rights Amendment, and defending women's reproductive rights.
